Chief justice, SC judges pay tributes to martyrs of 1971 Liberation War
2024-12-16T18:09:32+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/chief-justice-sc-judges-pay-tributes-martyrs-1971-liberation-war-3777776

Chief Justice Syed Refaat Ahmed and other judges of the Appellate and High Court Divisions of the Supreme Court today paid tributes to the martyrs of the Liberation War through placing wreaths at the National Memorial Monument in Savar on the occasion of the Victory Day.

After placing wreaths on the memorial early in the morning, the judges also observed silence in honour of the martyrs of the 1971 Liberation War of Bangladesh.
